artist.bio:
There are at least two artists with the name Colombo:

1) A breakbeat producer from Malaga, Spain, Alex Rojo aka Colombo has been in the breaks scene since 2007, releasing several studio albums and many singles on a variety of labels including iBreaks, Acida Records, and Low Groove Records.

2) A punk rock band . User-contributed text is available under the Creative Commons By-SA License; additional terms may apply.
